set.tovw: Unconfirmed legend; stranger's map dig found nothing
set.t: Unconfirmed legend; the stranger's dig found nothing. Urban lot: look-only.

tw-ia-cherokee-adsit-yard-1915.st: The Des Moines Register (26 Apr 1915) adds that the stranger had a secret map, dug and found nothing, and said he would return; the booty was said to have been 'buried by outlaws in an early day'. No recovery reported.
src: Des Moines Register, 26 Apr 1915, p. 3 'Mysterious Stranger With Secret Chart Thickens Plot' (newspapers.com 129296626; same wire Waterloo Courier 26 Apr p. 5)
